title: Electronic Equipment Installers and Repairers, Motor Vehicles
description: Install, diagnose, or repair communications, sound, security, or navigation equipment in motor vehicles.

tasks.text: Estimate costs of repairs, based on parts and labor charges.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Labor/material cost estimation from rates

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Install equipment and accessories, such as stereos, navigation equipment, communication equipment, and security systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing AV equipment requires hands-on wiring

tasks.text: Inspect and test electrical or electronic systems to locate and diagnose malfunctions, using visual inspections and testing instruments, such as oscilloscopes and voltmeters.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Inspect electrical or electronic systems for defects.
Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Diagnose or repair problems with electronic equipment, such as sound, navigation, communication, and security equipment, in motor vehicles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electronic equipment repair

tasks.text: Confer with customers to determine the nature of malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Assessing customer problems needs live diagnostic dialogue

dwas.name: Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.rationale: text generation — Write test result reports from data

tasks.text: Splice wires with knives or cutting pliers, and solder connections to fixtures and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Solder parts or connections between parts.

tasks.text: Run new speaker and electrical cables.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying cables requires physical routing work

tasks.text: Remove seats, carpeting, and interiors of doors and add sound-absorbing material in empty spaces, reinstalling interior parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing vehicle parts requires hands-on mechanical work

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.
Remove parts or components from vehicles.

tasks.text: Replace and clean electrical or electronic components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical component-level repair work

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Cut openings and drill holes for fixtures and equipment, using electric drills and routers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Build fiberglass or wooden enclosures for sound components, and fit them to automobile dimensions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling
